name: Fuzzy wuzzy sedge
desc: Fuzzy wuzzy sedge (Carex hirsutella): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex hirsutella, the hairy green sedge or fuzzy wuzzy sedge, is a species of North American sedge that was first described by Kenneth Mackenzie in 1923.
